meta.title: Seattle Eastside — the Chinese food meta
meta.subtitle: Bellevue is the center; the useful scene extends well beyond it
meta.intro: A curated, evidence-based map of Chinese and Taiwanese dining across Bellevue, Redmond, Kirkland, Issaquah, Sammamish, Factoria, Bel-Red, and Overlake. It is organized by cluster, regional lane, dish, and daypart rather than one popularity ranking, with operational conflicts and research gaps kept visible.

hubs.name: Bel-Red / NE 20th corridor
hubs.summary: The Eastside's deepest Chinese-food cluster, with Hunan, Sichuan, Lanzhou noodles, dumplings, Taiwanese snacks, barbecue, and claypot cooking spread through utilitarian plazas.

dayparts.breakfast: Master Bing is outside the corridor but is the stronger early option.
dayparts.lunch: Excellent; many specialists serve lunch, though several keep an afternoon break.
dayparts.late: Nuodle is the clearest verified late option.

sources.label: KUOW overview of Bellevue's Chinese-food depth

hubs.notes:
Treat this as a drive-and-park corridor, not a walkable restaurant row. The useful
definition stretches beyond NE 20th itself to nearby Crossroads and Lake Hills.

hubs.name: Downtown Bellevue
hubs.summary: Polished, reservation-friendly Chinese dining: hot pot, soup dumplings, Peking duck, and mall-adjacent group meals.

dayparts.lunch: Strong for business meals and dumplings.
dayparts.dinner: Strongest use; reserve for peak periods and groups.
dayparts.late: Haidilao is the most dependable late-night anchor.

hubs.notes:
Downtown is easier for groups and transit than Bel-Red, but generally pricier and
less specialist-driven.

hubs.name: Factoria
hubs.summary: A practical south-Bellevue cluster led by T&T Supermarket's large prepared-food ecosystem, plus dim sum and northern Chinese options nearby.

dayparts.breakfast: T&T bakery and prepared foods are the best fit.
dayparts.lunch: Strong for grazing, shopping, and casual groups.
dayparts.dinner: Useful, but quality varies more than in Bel-Red.

sources.label: T&T first US store opening and food departments
City of Bellevue Factoria existing-conditions report

hubs.notes:
T&T is a hub record as much as a venue: bakery, deli, street-food counters, dim
sum, noodles, and groceries support several different visits.

hubs.name: Overlake / 152nd
hubs.summary: A compact, transit-improving pocket whose strongest Chinese anchor is 151 Days Chicken Soup House, with Asian retail and bakeries nearby.

dayparts.breakfast: Bakery use is stronger than restaurant use.
dayparts.dinner: Good for destination meals; watch split hours.

sources.label: Eastside growth, diversity, and transit context

hubs.notes:
Do not collapse Overlake into downtown Redmond; it has a different transit and
shopping pattern.

hubs.name: Downtown Redmond
hubs.summary: A small but improving cluster: Hunan at Dong Ting Chun, newly reopened Hakka House, and a new Supreme Dumplings branch.

dayparts.dinner: Improving; Hakka House adds a distinctive regional lane.

sources.label: Hakka House reopening and signature dish

hubs.notes:
The corpus keeps the very new Supreme Dumplings branch in the lead ledger until
branch-specific evidence matures.

hubs.name: North Rose Hill / 124th
hubs.area: North Rose Hill and Totem Lake fringe
hubs.summary: A modest pair of specialist options—Fang's noodles and Dim Sum Yuan—rather than a deep district.

dayparts.lunch: Best use for noodles or made-to-order dim sum.
dayparts.dinner: Viable, with more limited evidence than Bellevue.

hubs.notes:
Downtown Kirkland has a Supreme Dumplings branch, but the 124th-area specialists
provide more distinct research value.

hubs.name: Downtown Issaquah
hubs.summary: Dan Gui brings serious Sichuan cooking while Macky's supplies a long-running neighborhood dim-sum role.

dayparts.lunch: Useful, especially for dim sum or a quieter Dan Gui meal.

hubs.notes:
This is a two-anchor micro-cluster, not evidence that Issaquah matches Bellevue's
depth.

hubs.name: Sammamish Plateau
hubs.summary: A convenience-oriented neighborhood market, with August Moon as the clearest enduring Chinese-American anchor.

dayparts.dinner: Family takeout and familiar Chinese-American dishes.

sources.label: August Moon first-party hours and menu

hubs.notes:
The thin record is intentional. Sammamish belongs in coverage, but the evidence
does not support portraying it as a destination cluster.

restaurants.name: Shaoshan Impression
restaurants.address: 14150 NE 20th St, Suite C, Bellevue, WA 98007
restaurants.parking: Plaza lot; weekend waits are reported

dishes.name: Steamed fish head with chopped chile

cautions: Closing times were not consistently exposed by the first-party page; recheck same-day.

sources.label: Bellevue visitor listing and weekend-use signal

restaurants.notes:
The strongest destination-level regional restaurant in this first pass. Heat,
smoke, preserved flavors, and sharing-size dishes matter more than generic ranking.

restaurants.name: Supreme Dumplings — Bellevue
restaurants.groupFit: Medium; excellent for two to four
restaurants.otherEastsideLocations: Kirkland and Redmond Town Center; each branch is tracked separately as a lead.
cautions: Do not copy these hours or status to the newer Redmond branch.
restaurants.notes:
Branch-specific evidence is mature in Bellevue; the Eastside expansion should not
be treated as one interchangeable venue.

restaurants.name: Dan Gui Sichuan Cuisine — Bellevue

dishes.name: Tofu pudding fish
dishes.note: Soft tofu and chile-forward fish specialty

cautions: The transactional page displays an unusual 207-area-code phone number; confirm before relying on it.
restaurants.notes:
One of the corpus's clearest Sichuan recommendations, with an Issaquah branch
maintained as a separate operational record.

restaurants.name: Little Garden
cautions: Split hours make midafternoon visits risky.
restaurants.notes:
Less hype-driven than Shaoshan Impression but still an important part of the
corridor's unusually deep Hunan lane.

restaurants.name: Nuodle

dishes.name: Lanzhou beef noodle soup
dishes.note: Choose noodle shape and chile level

dishes.name: Cold skin noodles
dishes.note: Useful contrasting side or warm-weather order

cautions: Do not label the restaurant halal without direct current certification evidence.
restaurants.notes:
A high-utility specialist: inexpensive, fast, and unusually late by Eastside
standards.

restaurants.name: Looking for Chai
cautions: Some current directories show Tuesday open; the first-party site says closed, so call if Tuesday matters.
restaurants.notes:
Useful because it fills a Taiwanese snack-and-tea lane rather than duplicating a
formal dinner restaurant.

restaurants.name: Mr. Huang Claypot Braised Chicken
cautions: Regional labeling is kept broad; the available evidence does not justify a narrower province claim.
restaurants.notes: A focused one-pot concept that adds format diversity to the guide.

restaurants.name: Frying Fish

dishes.name: Chile-forward fish preparations
dishes.note: Order around the kitchen's fish strength

cautions: The independent quality signal is established but less recent than its operational evidence.
restaurants.notes:
A long-running Sichuan choice whose role is clearest for groups ordering fish and
several shared dishes.

restaurants.name: Shanghai Dumpling King
cautions: No robust first-party website was found; hours rely on a current map listing.
restaurants.notes:
Opened in 2024 and now supported by enough dish-specific evidence to graduate from
the lead ledger.

restaurants.name: Lucky Barbecue & Noodle House
restaurants.operationalConflict: Current sources disagree between 14509 and 14505 NE 20th and between 9am and 11am opening.
cautions: Confirm the exact unit and opening time; the plaza location is stable but directories conflict.
restaurants.notes:
Its value is tactical: roast meats, noodles, and prepared-food pickup adjacent to
an Asian grocery, not a polished destination dinner.

restaurants.name: Haidilao Hot Pot — Bellevue
restaurants.bestDaypart: Late dinner or celebratory group meal

dishes.name: Split-pot broths
dishes.note: Lets a mixed-preference table compare styles

cautions: Prime periods can involve waits; reserve or join the queue early.
restaurants.notes: The guide's strongest late-night and service-forward group option.

restaurants.name: The Dolar Shop — Bellevue

dishes.name: Individual broth pots
dishes.note: Better fit for mixed diets and preferences

cautions: Price rises quickly with premium proteins.
restaurants.notes:
More polished and individually portioned than Haidilao; choose based on group style,
not an absolute ranking.

restaurants.name: Din Tai Fung — Bellevue
cautions: Mall crowds and waits can dominate the experience at peak times.
restaurants.notes:
Not the newest choice, but operationally dependable and unusually easy to plan for
larger or mixed-experience groups.

restaurants.name: Baron's Sino Kitchen & Bar
restaurants.address: 500 Bellevue Way NE, Suite 210, Bellevue, WA 98004
restaurants.groupFit: Very high; reservations and private rooms

dishes.name: Peking duck
dishes.note: Primary destination order; plan a group

cautions: A poor fit for a quick or inexpensive solo meal.
restaurants.notes:
The corpus includes it for a specific use case—Peking duck, corporate meals, and
private dining—not as the default picture of Eastside Chinese food.

restaurants.name: Master Bing — Bellevue
cautions: Ordering page is the primary operational evidence; recheck on holidays.
restaurants.notes:
It fills a rare early-morning gap and should be surfaced by daypart, not buried in
a dinner-heavy ranking.

restaurants.name: T&T Supermarket — Factoria prepared foods
restaurants.format: Supermarket food hall, bakery, and deli
restaurants.bestDaypart: Breakfast through early dinner; counter availability varies
restaurants.groupFit: High for grazing, low for formal seating

dishes.name: Dim sum and hot deli
dishes.note: Inspect what is fresh rather than precommitting

cautions: This record covers prepared foods, not every concession; counter hours can be shorter than market hours.
restaurants.notes:
Opened December 2024 as T&T's first US store. Its research value is breadth and
repeat utility, not a single signature dish.

restaurants.name: North All You Can Eat Dumplings

dishes.name: Soup dumplings
dishes.note: Check current inclusion and batch quality

cautions: A promising new operation with limited independent track record; verify price and hours.

sources.label: Current destination listing and concept details

restaurants.notes: Included visibly as a new lead, not prematurely promoted to a proven staple.

restaurants.name: 151 Days Chicken Soup House

dishes.name: Chicken noodle soup
dishes.note: Made around the restaurant's own slow-raised chickens

cautions: Closed Tuesday and between services; time the visit carefully.
restaurants.notes:
One of Redmond's few true destination specialists, built around ingredient sourcing
rather than menu sprawl.

restaurants.name: Dong Ting Chun
restaurants.operationalConflict: Town Center and current directory sources disagree on split hours and 8pm versus 8:30pm closing.

dishes.name: Hunan stir-fries
dishes.note: Order chile-forward regional dishes rather than generic defaults

cautions: Verify same-day hours, especially the afternoon break.
restaurants.notes:
An important Redmond regional anchor, but current evidence does not justify a more
specific dish hierarchy yet.

restaurants.name: Hakka House
restaurants.region: Hakka with Taiwanese, Cantonese, and Fujian lanes

dishes.name: Pork-stuffed tofu (yong tau foo)
dishes.note: The signature that best exposes the Hakka identity

cautions: Reopened in Redmond in 2026; older Bellevue address results are stale.
restaurants.notes:
The most important 2026 Eastside reopening in this research pass, and a regional
lane that Bellevue's Hunan/Sichuan concentration does not duplicate.

restaurants.name: Dan Gui Sichuan Cuisine — Issaquah
restaurants.parking: Olde Town street and public parking
restaurants.operationalConflict: Transactional ordering shows Tuesday service while a current map listing shows Tuesday closed.
cautions: Call before a Tuesday visit; do not inherit Bellevue branch hours blindly.
restaurants.notes:
This gives Issaquah a serious regional destination while preserving branch-level
uncertainty.

restaurants.name: August Moon Chinese Restaurant

dishes.name: Familiar Chinese-American standards
dishes.note: Neighborhood comfort and convenience are the evidence-backed use case

cautions: Do not present this as a regional-specialist destination; its value is local reliability.
restaurants.notes:
Included to make Sammamish coverage useful without pretending the Plateau has
Bellevue's density or regional range.

restaurants.name: Tasty House
restaurants.operationalConflict: Fresh editorial and local listings indicate operation, while some directory pages label it closed.
cautions: Call before making a special trip because closure flags conflict.
restaurants.notes:
Kept visible as a watch record: the food signal is strong enough to retain, but
operational disagreement prevents a high-confidence recommendation.

restaurants.name: Facing East Taiwanese Restaurant
restaurants.address: 1075 Bellevue Way NE, Suite B2, Bellevue, WA 98004
restaurants.bestDaypart: Lunch or dinner after confirming location
restaurants.operationalConflict: The brand site still shows the former 12736 Bel-Red Road takeout-only location, while current downtown sources place it in the Brio building.
cautions: Confirm current address, dine-in status, and hours directly before publishing operational details.
restaurants.notes:
Editorially important to Eastside Taiwanese food, but deliberately quarantined as
a watch record until its first-party location information catches up.

restaurants.name: Fang's Noodle House

dishes.name: Beef-rib dry noodles
dishes.note: Most specific current local recommendation signal

cautions: Current customer evidence is mixed by dish and service; treat as a specialist option, not a blanket endorsement.
restaurants.notes:
Kirkland's evidence is thinner than Bellevue's; this record says exactly what the
current signal supports and no more.

restaurants.name: Dim Sum Yuan

dishes.name: Made-to-order dim sum
dishes.note: All-day availability is the key use case

cautions: Independent editorial coverage is limited; retain medium confidence until another evidence cycle.
restaurants.notes:

modest confidence.
